customManagers.description: Versions pinned on the line after a `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` comment (dx CLI, gitleaks) in CI, the README and the Dockerfile. rust-toolchain.toml is handled by the built-in manager

packageRules.description: Group minor updates to limit PR noise. They wait for the maintainer.
Group patch updates and automerge them once the required CI checks pass.
The dioxus crates and the dx CLI (dioxus-cli, pinned in CI, README and Dockerfile) must always move together, in one PR.
